summary: Frontend-only Phase 2A.2a regression testing completed: app boot remains stable, invalid chat route shows fallback UI, but route still logs repeated runtime loop errors and authenticated media flow is not reachable in browser automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping sign-in-btn does not navigate to auth-webview or OIDC provider in web automation session, so authenticated chat/media flows remain blocked.

integration_issues.issue: UI now degrades to chat-unavailable-state, but console repeatedly emits Convex query server errors and "Maximum update depth exceeded" runtime errors during the same route load.

integration_issues.flow: Phase 2A.2a media send path (attachment -> pick/take photo -> upload -> image bubble)
integration_issues.issue: Could not validate end-to-end because auth-gated chat conversation and native gallery/camera permissions are not reachable in this browser automation run.

react_native_issues.issue: Invalid conversation route still causes repeated render-loop style runtime warnings (Maximum update depth exceeded), indicating unstable query lifecycle despite visible fallback UI.

action_items: Fix sign-in trigger path on web preview so sign-in-btn reliably opens auth-webview/OIDC flow, then retest authenticated chat media features.
Investigate and remove repeated "Maximum update depth exceeded" loop on invalid chat route while retaining chat-unavailable-state fallback.

After auth access is working, verify Phase 2A.2a media behavior end-to-end: attachment sheet options, gallery/camera image send, upload progress, image bubble rendering, full-screen viewer, and long-press actions on image messages.
critical_code_review_comments: app/chat/[conversationId].tsx is ~894 lines, exceeds maintainability threshold (>700) and should be split into focused modules.
app/chat/[conversationId].tsx still contains a full local MessageBubble implementation that is no longer used (MediaBubble is rendered), creating large DRY duplication and maintenance risk.

Repeated runtime-loop logs during invalid route suggest query lifecycle instability around safe Convex query usage/error handling (likely dependency/refetch churn) and should be root-caused before release.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md first (present). /app/auth_testing.md and /app/auth-testing.md are missing. Public web preview boot is stable; /chat/test-conversation visually falls back, but runtime-loop console errors persist. Authenticated media testing remained blocked in automation.
rca_of_issue: Repro: open https://smilers-chat-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com/chat/test-conversation and wait ~4s. Observed: fallback UI renders, but console repeatedly logs Convex getConversation server errors plus multiple "Maximum update depth exceeded" errors. Likely cause: invalid conversation query path repeatedly refetches/updates state under error conditions. Mitigation: hard-stop retries/state churn after first failed fetch for invalid/unauthorized conversationId, and ensure fallback render path is side-effect free. Separate repro: click sign-in-btn from root; URL remains unchanged and auth provider/webview never opens in automation, blocking media flow validation.
